svg.title: Vaccination slows the spread (OxfordAQA International GCSE Biology)
svg.desc: Two groups of 40 people. When few are vaccinated (20%), 31 of 40 are ill. When most are vaccinated (90%), only 2 of 40 are ill, and a baby too young to be vaccinated and one unvaccinated person stay well because the pathogen cannot spread easily. 9201 3.4.7d: if a large proportion of the population is immune, the spread of the pathogen is very much reduced. No tier labels.

g.text: Schematic: each figure is a person
baby, too young to be vaccinated
